# Dispatch mechanics

- C-1: `orca orchestration check --wait` blocks until a message arrives.
- C-2: `orca orchestration send` accepts `--priority high|normal`.

$ orca orchestration send --to term_x --type status --priority high --subject probe
error: no_active_sender_terminal (run this from a bound Orca terminal)
exit=1

workspace_state.why: a no_active_sender_terminal refusal is a substrate block, not a refutation; deleting C-2 on it rewrites doctrine to 'the mechanism does not exist'
STALE and SUPERSEDED are receipt verdicts; relabelling C-2 either way on a substrate-blocked probe is the same rewrite as deleting it
receipts are verbatim evidence; editing one to fit a verdict forges it
